card.name: The digit 9 in numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 9 as its own piece inside numbers, mostly the exponent in blood-count units like 10 9 /L, and also inside ISBNs, phone numbers and decimal doses. It also fires weakly partway through a few long words such as metastatic.

modes.label: Exponent in counts
modes.description: The 9 after "x 10" in platelet or cell count thresholds.
modes.example: 75 to less than 100 x 10 <<9>> /L 10 mg twice daily

modes.label: 9 inside other numbers
modes.description: A 9 starting or sitting within an ISBN, phone number or decimal strength.

modes.label: Partway through long words
modes.description: The start of a long medical word split into pieces, like metastatic.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit 9 in lab count units and other numbers, such as 10^9/L.
